definitions.explanation: The monetary amount of 1,000 Japanese yen. A common denomination in everyday transactions.

examples.japanese: {千円|せんえん}⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid with a 1,000 yen bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千円|せんえん}くらいだ。
{千円|せんえん}⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for something I can buy for under 1,000 yen.

notes:
{千円|せんえん} is one of the most commonly used monetary amounts in Japan.

CURRENCY:
- {千円|せんえん}⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧: 1,000 yen bill
- Features {北里|きたさと}{柴三郎|しばさぶろう} (bacteriologist) on current bills (2024-)
- Previously featured {野口|のぐち}{英世|ひでよ}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {千円|せんえん}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly 1,000 yen
- {千円|せんえん}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧: within 1,000 yen
- {千円|せんえん}⟦カット→カット：10818_katto⟧: 1,000 yen haircut (budget hair salon)
- {千円|せんえん}⟦{均一|きんいつ}→均一：12049_kinitsu⟧: all items 1,000 yen

RELATED AMOUNTS:
- {五千円|ごせんえん}: 5,000 yen
- {一万円|いちまんえん}: 10,000 yen
- {百円|ひゃくえん}: 100 yen
